sections.title: Managing eProcurement Contracts
paragraphs: • Quick and easy for the customer to set up, make available in item search, and manage (no JAGGAER or supplier support needed)
• Items have fewer attributes than hosted catalog
• Items must be associated with a contract
• Admins must have access to the contract to administer it
• Does not validate commodity and UOM (packaging) codes
